entries.5e335b287923a137: The company manufactures and sells compound feed for fish farming, Nagaya Suisan Co., Ltd. sells fresh seafood and compound feed for fish farming, and Amami Kurumaebi Co., Ltd. cultivates and sells kuruma prawns. The business consists of manufacturing and sales of feed for fish farming such as kuruma prawns and yellowtail, sales of farmed fish such as sea bream and yellowtail, and cultivation of kuruma prawns. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,740 million.
entries.71225b4da59baf44: Since its founding, it has accumulated experience in focusing on research and development of compound feed, including completing its research institute in 1981 and taking over the feed demonstration test business from the Kagoshima Prefectural Fisheries Experiment Station. Within the group, it handles everything from feed manufacturing to kuruma prawn aquaculture, and has a structure that allows knowledge from aquaculture sites to be used in feed development.
entries.7176605b7fd69bd4: As its medium- to long-term management strategy, it says it will develop highly profitable and competitive products through innovative research looking 5 and 10 years ahead. In its main Fisheries Business, it is working on developing feed that does not depend excessively on fishmeal, a raw material, and it has obtained “ISO22000,” the international standard for food safety management systems, in both the Food Business and the Fisheries Business, pursuing quality and safety.
entries.791af4e4cd4d6687: The composition in which the Fisheries Business accounts for more than half of revenue continues this period. The company says it will focus on high value-added products and review its production structure; whether it can strengthen product competitiveness in both the feed and food businesses, starting from research and development, will be key to future revenue mix and profitability.
